findings.finding: The original focused test trusted compact booleans and did not rehash raw evidence.
findings.disposition: Added a read-only validator that rehashes raw local/remote records and the build log, verifies chronology, exact source hashes, commit equality, registry binding, identities, and nonpromotion. Added positive and tamper tests.

findings.finding: The commit-prefixed registry tag remains mutable or rebuildable.
findings.disposition: Future Jobs must use the registry repository at the observed OCI digest, never latest or a tag alone. No Job is authorized by R3.

findings.finding: The R3 source directory references the R2 runner and did not record the exact build context.
findings.disposition: The runbook now records the exact cross-directory Docker build command. Frozen source and evidence were not edited.

findings.finding: OpenFOAM apt transitive dependencies are not all independently version-pinned.
findings.disposition: Retained as an infrastructure reproducibility limitation; exact local and remote OCI digests contain it.
